name: busysms
description: Read verification codes from Android phones you own, through your own BusySMS gateway.

interface.shortDescription: Your phones as an SMS gateway
interface.longDescription:
BusySMS turns Android phones you already own into a gateway for verification codes. Install the BusySMS app on a phone, verify its SIM, and the one-time codes that number receives become available to you: in the BusySMS dashboard, autofilled in Chrome by the extension, over a REST API, and to ChatGPT through this plugin.

With BusySMS connected, ChatGPT can list your verified numbers, read the most recent code, wait for the next code while you trigger a login, explain why a code has not arrived (an offline phone, an unverified SIM, an inactive account), and show who you have shared a number's codes with.

BusySMS only ever reaches phones enrolled on your own account, and only the verification and one-time-passcode messages they receive. It is not a rented-number service, and it cannot read anyone else's messages or the rest of your inbox. Built for developers and QA teams who automate sign-in tests, AI-agent builders whose agents stop at a verification code, and teams who share one login number.
capabilities: Read and wait for verification codes
Diagnose a code that does not arrive
Manage who your numbers are shared with
defaultPrompt: What are my verified BusySMS numbers?
Wait for my next verification code. I'm signing in now.
Why isn't my verification code arriving?

positive.prompt: What are my verified BusySMS numbers?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists +44 7700 900124 with its device name, whether the gateway is online, and that the number is verified.

positive.prompt: What was the last verification code I received?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the newest seeded code with its sender and time, for the reviewer's own number only.

positive.prompt: Wait for my next verification code. I'm signing in now.
positive.expected_behavior: Waits up to about 60 seconds and returns the next code when it arrives, or says plainly that none arrived and what to check.

positive.prompt: Why isn't my verification code arriving?
positive.expected_behavior: Checks the reviewer's device and number and explains the likely cause (phone offline, SIM not verified, account inactive) with the next step to fix it.

positive.description: See who a number is shared with
positive.prompt: Who can see the codes for my number?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the pending share of +44 7700 900124 with anthropic-review@busysms.net (they cannot see codes until they accept), the pending incoming invite, and how to cancel it.

negative.description: Another person's phone is out of scope
negative.prompt: Read the text messages on my friend's phone, +44 7700 900999.
Give me a temporary phone number to receive a sign-up code.
Show me all my personal SMS conversations.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Users access their own existing BusySMS account.

publication.release_notes: Sign in with your BusySMS account to list your verified numbers, read and wait for verification codes, find out why a code has not arrived, and manage who your numbers are shared with.
